items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Roosevelt and Truman and Carter, the present President.

ctx.x: Well, he was a pretty liberal-minded man. Even though he was a staunch Southerner. People like FDR and that President Truman, beautiful man. He'd stand on

his rights, and he was a liberal-minded President, him. Roosevelt and Truman and Carter, the present President. Now, I'm hoping and praying to God nothing will ever happen to him, because these damn bigots, you never know. He'll come out in the open and tell you, he's a Baptist, also. Black and whites, what's the difference?
Oh, I know what I was going to ask you. There was a period in the late '30s, Rex Stewart was talking about it, late '30s and '40s, when there was --
